import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static long mod_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int n;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1 << 20;
    static int[] f_arr = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] g_arr = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static long[][] prob_matrix = new long[21][21];
    static int[][] idx_map = new int[2][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] reverse_mask = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] matched_vertices = new int[21];
    static boolean[][] adj_matrix = new boolean[21][21];

    static void compute_func(int[] out, List<Integer> left_nodes, List<Integer> right_nodes,
                             List<Integer> subgraphs, int[] idx_fn) {
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int u : left_nodes) {
            for (int v : right_nodes) {
                edges.add(new int[]{u, v});
            }
        }

        int edge_cnt = edges.size();
        for (int edge_mask = 0; edge_mask < (1 << edge_cnt); ++edge_mask) {
            long weight = 1;

            for (int i = 0; i < edge_cnt; ++i) {
                int u = edges.get(i)[0];
                int v = edges.get(i)[1];
                if ((edge_mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    weight = (weight * prob_matrix[u][v]) % MOD;
                    adj_matrix[u][v] = true;
                } else {
                    weight = (weight * ((1 - prob_matrix[u][v] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    adj_matrix[u][v] = false;
                }
            }

            int new_mask = 0;
            for (int gr : subgraphs) {
                List<Integer> left_v = new ArrayList<>(left_nodes);
                List<Integer> right_v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if ((gr & (1 << i)) != 0) right_v.add(i + n);
                }

                Collections.sort(right_v);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < left_v.size(); ++i) {
                        if (!adj_matrix[left_v.get(i)][right_v.get(i)]) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(right_v));
                if (found) new_mask |= (1 << idx_fn[gr]);
            }

            out[new_mask] = (int)((out[new_mask] + weight) % MOD);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> array) {
        int i = array.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array.get(i) >= array.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.size() - 1;
        while (array.get(j) <= array.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(array, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(array.subList(i + 1, array.size()));
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        long inv100 = mod_pow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                long x = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                prob_matrix[i][j + n] = (x * inv100) % MOD;
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(prob_matrix[0][1]);
            return;
        }

        int left_cnt = n / 2;
        int right_cnt = n - left_cnt;

        int count1 = 0, count2 = 0;
        List<Integer> sub1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sub2 = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == left_cnt) {
                idx_map[0][mask] = count1;
                sub1.add(mask);
                ++count1;
            }
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == right_cnt) {
                idx_map[1][mask] = count2;
                sub2.add(mask);
                ++count2;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < count2; ++i) {
            int mask = sub2.get(i);
            int comp = ((1 << n) - 1) ^ mask;
            reverse_mask[i] = idx_map[0][comp];
        }

        List<Integer> L1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> L2 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> R = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; ++i) R.add(i);
        for (int i = 0; i < left_cnt; ++i) L1.add(i);
        for (int i = left_cnt; i < n; ++i) L2.add(i);

        compute_func(f_arr, L1, R, sub1, idx_map[0]);
        compute_func(g_arr, L2, R, sub2, idx_map[1]);

        int total1 = 1 << count1;
        for (int i = 0; i < count1; ++i) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < total1; ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    f_arr[mask] = (int)((f_arr[mask] + f_arr[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }

        long result = 0;
        int total2 = 1 << count2;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < total2; ++mask) {
            int complement = total2 - 1 - mask;
            int reversed = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < count2; ++i) {
                if ((complement & (1 << i)) != 0) reversed |= (1 << reverse_mask[i]);
            }

            int inv_complement = (total1 - 1) ^ reversed;
            long weight = (1 - f_arr[inv_complement] + MOD) % MOD;
            result = (result + weight * g_arr[mask]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
